suggestions.title: Gate the Chinese /compare/ capability matrix against matrix.csv, the way the English one already is
suggestions.why: tests/pages.test.js:567 reads only `shipped.get("compare/index.html")` in the case that keeps the HTML matrix and `public/compare/matrix.csv` identical, while site/pages/zh/compare/index.html:158-169 is a second hand copy of the same twelve `<tr data-product=…>` rows that no test compares with the CSV. tests/pages.test.js:579-585 already loops over both languages for the neighbouring 'every cell links to its dated source' case, so this one case is the only gap: edit a ZH row and only the English page is protected.
suggestions.body:
## Request

Extend the capability-matrix gate to the Chinese page. `tests/pages.test.js:566` ('keeps the HTML table and downloadable CSV row and column sets identical') compares only `compare/index.html` with `public/compare/matrix.csv`. `site/pages/zh/compare/index.html:158-169` carries the same twelve products as an independent hand copy, and nothing checks it for drift.

## User outcome

A reader of `/zh/compare/` never sees a capability claim that differs from the English matrix or from the CSV they download: the ZH table either matches `public/compare/matrix.csv` or CI goes red on the pull request that broke it.

## Acceptance

1. The case at `tests/pages.test.js:566` covers `zh/compare/index.html` as well as `compare/index.html`, with the same assertion shape it uses today: header cells equal to the CSV header minus `source_url,verified`; each `<tr data-product=…>` equal to its CSV row minus the same two columns.
2. The gate can go red: changing one cell's text in `site/pages/zh/compare/index.html`, rebuilding, and running `npm test` fails it with the ZH page and the offending product named; reverting the change brings it back to green.
3. `npm test` and `npm run test:ui` pass with the matrix as it ships today, and `npm run build` produces no diff under `public/` — this Issue changes a test, not the pages.
4. Markup differences that are not capability data stay out of the comparison: the ZH row headers carry no `alternatives` sub-links (those sections are English-only), so only product names and the six `<td>` values are compared.

## Evidence

- `tests/pages.test.js:566-577` — one case, `shipped.get("compare/index.html")` only.
- `site/pages/zh/compare/index.html:158-169` — twelve hand-written rows, same products, same English cell values as the CSV.
- `tests/pages.test.js:579-585` — the sibling case (`links every capability cell to its dated source`) already iterates over both `compare/index.html` and `zh/compare/index.html`, so the ZH page is inside this gate family; only the CSV-equality case skips it.
- `public/compare/matrix.csv` is the downloadable canonical and is also injected into `public/llms-full.txt` by the build, so a ZH row that drifts from it ships a different claim to Chinese readers and to AI crawlers reading the accessible text.

## Not included

- Adding products the matrix is missing (for example Keelen, which already has `/compare/keelen/` plus a deep-dive entry) — that is a data change with its own sourcing work.
- Rendering both matrices from the CSV so that only one copy exists — no request for that here.
